role_voices.text_zh: 二娘姊姊也跟我一樣，嫉惡如仇，只不過……她懲罰貪官的手段好像有點太狠了……
role_voices.text_en: Sister Erniang despises evil, just like me. It's just that... her methods for punishing corrupt officials seem a bit too harsh...

role_voices.text_zh: 小次郎姊姊的太刀好長，比我還要高！可是她揮起刀來，卻像揮短刀一樣輕鬆如意！
role_voices.text_en: Sister Kojiro's tachi is so long, it's taller than I am! But when she swings it, she does it as effortlessly as if it were a short sword!

role_voices.text_zh: 哦……原來魔王也能冥想這麼久，真厲害！咦……？欸！結果魔王也睡著啦！
role_voices.text_en: Oh! So you can meditate for this long too, Archfiend. That's really impressive! Huh...? Hey! Turns out you fell asleep too!

role_voices.text_zh: 啊嗯嗯！魔王！又在打擾我冥想了……你要負起責任讓我平靜下來喔♥
role_voices.text_en: Annhh! Archfiend! You're disturbing my meditation again... You'll have to take responsibility for calming me down now♥

role_voices.text_zh: 那個……魔王，我需要進入賢者時間一下，你可以幫我嗎？♥
role_voices.text_en: Um... Lord Archfiend, I need to enter Sage Time for a moment. Can you help me? ♥
I urge you to reflect on your actions!
Don't underestimate me just because I'm short!
Those who do evil will surely be punished!

role_voices.text_zh: 而我，就是你們的「惡報」！接招——！
role_voices.text_en: And I am your ‘retribution!' Take this—!

role_voices.text_zh: 唔……！你們這些……可惡的…壞蛋……
啊哈！那接下來……就是慶祝的時候了，對吧？
role_voices.text_en: Aha! Well then... it's time to celebrate, right?
